states.historical_question: What viable MSc research direction in soft robotics variable stiffness can be formed from 54 seed papers?
states.claim_at_time: Layer jamming for variable-stiffness continuum robots is a scientifically novel and defensible research direction.
assumptions_at_time: 54 seed papers represent sufficient literature coverage of layer jamming.
Interlayer friction and pressure-stiffness coupling have not been comprehensively modeled.
states.evidence_not_yet_available: Narang 2018, Caruso 2023, Zhang 2025, and subsequent targeted verification corpora.
states.scientific_interpretation_at_time: D1 is novel because seed papers did not contain an integrated continuum layer-jamming beam model.
uncertainties_at_time: Discovery corpus may suffer from selection bias.
True extent of prior art in mechanical engineering / composite mechanics unknown.
states.decision_at_time: Select D1 with revision; initiate independent verification corpus D1-V001.
states.next_action_at_time: Attack D1 using external verification literature.
states.reason_for_change: Direct prior art (Narang 2018, Caruso 2023) established that layer jamming mechanics and stiffness models were already solved.
states.corrected_interpretation: Discovery corpus alone cannot prove novelty; absence of evidence in 54 seed papers was not global absence.

states.historical_question: Does direct prior art already model interlayer slip, pressure-dependent stiffness, and experimental hysteresis in vacuum layer jamming?
states.claim_at_time: P1 candidate: Homogenized slip model for high-layer-count vacuum-jammed beams may possess an unresolved validity limit.
assumptions_at_time: Prior art (Narang 2018, Caruso 2023) focused on low layer counts or discrete Euler-Bernoulli beams.
A continuum/homogenized model for large N has not been formulated or experimentally bounded.
states.evidence_available_at_time: Narang 2018 (laminar jamming), Caruso 2023 (modeling and validation), Atakuru 2024.
states.evidence_not_yet_available: Zhang et al. 2025 continuum beam model.
states.scientific_interpretation_at_time: Broad D1 is dead (verdict: PIVOT). Provisional pivot P1 formulated as a mechanics hypothesis.
uncertainties_at_time: P1 candidate is provisional and unverified against 2025-2026 forward citations.
states.decision_at_time: PIVOT to P1; rule: DO NOT DEFEND P1, ATTACK IT WITH 2025-2026 LITERATURE.
states.next_action_at_time: Forward-citation search of Narang 2018 and Caruso 2023 for 2025-2026 continuum models.
states.reason_for_change: Zhang et al. 2025 published a continuum layer-jamming beam model, forcing reformulation from proposing a model to evaluating validity limits of an existing model.
states.corrected_interpretation: P1 as an unvalidated proposal was attacked; Zhang 2025 eliminated the possibility of claiming a 'new continuum model'.

source_artifacts: data/papers/verification/D1-V002/2025-A continuum-based model for a layer jamming beam.pdf
states.historical_question: Has 2025 literature already developed a continuum model for layer jamming beams, and what are its exact equations and limitations?
states.claim_at_time: Zhang et al. (2025) continuum model represents baseline M1; research must evaluate validity limits of M1 rather than inventing M1.
assumptions_at_time: Zhang et al. model simplifies discrete layers into an equivalent continuum.
Model-form error will manifest when finite-layer discreteness and contact pressure redistribution dominate.
states.evidence_available_at_time: Zhang et al. 2025 ('A continuum-based model for a layer jamming beam', DOI: 10.5194/ms-16-821-2025).
states.evidence_not_yet_available: D1-V003 through D1-V009 multi-layered beam and contact mechanics audits.
states.scientific_interpretation_at_time: M1 is locked as the evaluation target. Architecture formalized as M -> R -> E.
uncertainties_at_time: Whether Zhang et al. or other 2025 authors already published validity breakdown maps.
states.decision_at_time: Lock M1 as target; initiate D1-V003 validity gap search.
states.next_action_at_time: Execute D1-V003 literature audit on validity limits.
states.reason_for_change: Refined into concrete 3-variable parameter space (layer count N x vacuum pressure p_vac x curvature kappa).
states.corrected_interpretation: Novelty lies strictly in model-form error mapping and breakdown mechanics, not in the continuum beam equations.

states.historical_question: Does literature on layer-jamming continuum models already characterize error boundaries and breakdown criteria?
states.claim_at_time: D1/M1 survives with revised scope: output-specific model-form error quantification across N x p_vac x bending severity.
assumptions_at_time: Fan 2026 and Zhang 2025b address continuum modeling/control but omit systematic model-form error boundaries against explicit contact FE.
Primary outputs (tip deflection, moment-curvature) have distinguishable validity limits.
states.evidence_available_at_time: 9 papers including Zhang 2025b ('Toward a deeper understanding'), Fan 2026 ('Modeling, Control, and Stiffness Regulation').
states.evidence_not_yet_available: Composite beam partial-interaction and contact mechanics literature (D1-V004..V009).
uncertainties_at_time: Could composite laminate relative gradient theory or partial interaction mechanics already cover this?
states.decision_at_time: Formulate candidate claims C01-C04 and attack with deep composite mechanics corpora (V004-V007).
states.reason_for_change: Scope further refined through C01-C04 audits and cross-direction comparison with MP1.
states.corrected_interpretation: Model survival requires predeclared error tolerances and explicit experimental contrast.

states.historical_question: Does composite gradient theory or laminated media slip homogenization pre-empt C01?
states.claim_at_time: C01: Discrete layer friction in vacuum jamming behaves distinctly from bonded composite relative gradient theories.
assumptions_at_time: Composite relative gradient theories assume bonded elastic interlayers or continuous cohesive zone laws.
states.evidence_available_at_time: 15 papers in gradient elasticity, composite laminates, slip-mediated bending.
states.scientific_interpretation_at_time: C01 survives in narrowed form. Gradient theories do not address vacuum confinement pressure coupling.
uncertainties_at_time: Partial interaction beam theories in civil engineering composite beams.
states.decision_at_time: Narrow C01; proceed to C02 audit.
states.next_action_at_time: Launch D1-V005 on multi-layer beam partial interaction.

states.historical_question: Does multi-layered beam partial interaction literature in civil/structural engineering solve vacuum jamming slip mechanics?
states.claim_at_time: C02: Partial interaction beam models are predominantly 2-layer steel-concrete; multi-layer unbonded frictional contact remains open.
assumptions_at_time: Steel-concrete composite models use linear spring shear connectors rather than normal-pressure-proportional Coulomb friction.
states.evidence_available_at_time: 16 papers on exact stiffness matrices and partial interaction beam elements.
states.scientific_interpretation_at_time: C02 survives in narrowed form. Vacuum pressure confinement cannot be represented by constant-stiffness shear connectors.
uncertainties_at_time: Whether joint friction or fretting literature provides direct solutions.
states.decision_at_time: Narrow C02; proceed to C03 audit on bolted joints and interface friction.

states.historical_question: Does interface friction, microscopic joint roughness, or fretting wear mechanics pre-empt C03?
states.claim_at_time: C03: Microscopic roughness contact redistribution does not provide closed continuum beam validity boundaries.
assumptions_at_time: Fretting wear and bolted joint models are localized to fastener regions, not beam-length continuum jamming.
states.evidence_available_at_time: 16 papers on joint interfaces, microscopic roughness, tangential friction.
states.scientific_interpretation_at_time: C03 survives in narrowed form. Macroscopic beam validity requires dedicated contact mechanics.
uncertainties_at_time: Whether forward citations of Zhang 2025 include multi-physics or chiral beam variants.
states.decision_at_time: Narrow C03; launch D1-V007 on forward citations of continuum beam models.

states.historical_question: Do recent 2026 forward citations (chiral, coupled electromagnetic models) solve the validity boundary of continuum jamming beams?
states.claim_at_time: C04: Forward citations address multi-physics extensions but do not validate continuum jamming breakdown.
assumptions_at_time: Focal paper ca46dc062d used a predeclared 5% acceptance tolerance.
states.scientific_interpretation_at_time: C04 survived, but review revealed a factual error: the 5% threshold was adopted post-hoc, NOT predeclared a priori.
uncertainties_at_time: Whether any literature paper actually predeclared an acceptance tolerance before validation.
states.decision_at_time: Apply semantic correction in C04_SEMANTIC_CORRECTION.md; require strict threshold freeze in execution plan.
states.corrected_interpretation: Paper ca46dc062d used an adopted threshold, not a predeclared tolerance. Predeclared tolerance is an unfulfilled scientific condition in prior art.

transitions.trigger: External verification against direct prior art (Narang 2018, Caruso 2023)
transitions.evidence: Narang 2018 and Caruso 2023 already modeled laminar jamming stiffness, slip transitions, and experimental validation.
transitions.decision: PIVOT: Falsify broad D1 claim; formulate provisional pivot P1.
transitions.scientific_consequence: Eliminated broad claim that layer jamming / variable stiffness continuum robots are novel in principle.

transitions.trigger: Forward-citation discovery of Zhang et al. 2025 continuum beam model
transitions.evidence: Zhang et al. (2025) published a continuum-based model for layer jamming beams, solving homogenized beam slip.
transitions.decision: REFORMULATE: Adopt Zhang et al. 2025 as baseline model M1; study its validity breakdown limits instead of inventing M1.
transitions.scientific_consequence: Shifted thesis architecture from 'model development' to 'model validity / model-form error quantification' (M -> R -> E).

transitions.trigger: D1-V003 validity gap search and cross-round synthesis
transitions.evidence: Literature (Zhang 2025b, Fan 2026) lacks systematic output-specific error maps across layer count and vacuum pressure.
transitions.decision: NARROW: Formulate candidate claims C01-C04 around explicit 3-variable space (N x p_vac x kappa).
transitions.scientific_consequence: Defined concrete falsifiable candidate claims C01-C04.

transitions.trigger: Adversarial audit against composite relative gradient theories
transitions.evidence: 15 papers in gradient elasticity; composite beam models rely on continuous shear interaction without vacuum pressure coupling.
transitions.decision: NARROW: C01 narrowed to vacuum-confinement frictional contact.
transitions.scientific_consequence: Separated layer jamming mechanics from bonded composite gradient theories.

transitions.trigger: Adversarial audit against multi-layered beam partial interaction models
transitions.evidence: 16 papers on exact stiffness matrices; partial interaction literature focuses on 2-layer steel-concrete with constant-stiffness shear connectors.
transitions.decision: NARROW: C02 narrowed to multi-layer frictional contact with pressure-dependent slip.
transitions.scientific_consequence: Differentiated civil engineering 2-layer composite beams from N-layer vacuum jamming beams.

transitions.trigger: Adversarial audit against interface friction and bolted joint roughness models
transitions.evidence: 16 papers on microscopic joint contact; contact pressure redistribution models do not solve continuum beam macroscopic validity boundaries.
transitions.decision: NARROW: C03 narrowed to beam-scale contact mechanics.
transitions.scientific_consequence: Established that joint roughness theories do not pre-empt continuum beam validity maps.

transitions.trigger: Review of C04 focal paper tolerance semantics
transitions.evidence: Focal paper ca46dc062d adopted a 5% error threshold post-hoc, but did NOT predeclare it a priori.
transitions.decision: CORRECT: Mark predeclared acceptance tolerance as unsupported in prior art; enforce a priori freeze in project governance.
transitions.scientific_consequence: Corrected factual inaccuracy in C04 audit; established requirement for threshold freeze (HG-06).

transitions.trigger: Targeted audits against Ye 2024 (D1-V008) and Adhikary 1999 (D1-V009)
transitions.evidence: Ye 2024 addresses 2-layer steel-concrete; Adhikary 1999 addresses Cosserat rock mechanics. Neither solves vacuum jamming validity breakdown.
transitions.decision: KEEP: Confirm survival of D1/M1 novelty lock against final named and adjacent targets.
transitions.scientific_consequence: D1 novelty verification workflow successfully completed with SURVIVES verdicts.

transitions.trigger: Final cross-direction adjudication D1/M1 vs MP1
transitions.evidence: 18-criterion comparison showed D1/M1 has concrete M1 baseline, fewer confounding variables, lower experimental instrumentation risk.
transitions.decision: LOCK_WITH_FEASIBILITY_GATE: Select D1_M1 as MSc thesis topic; archive MP1 as viable alternative.
transitions.scientific_consequence: Final selection of D1/M1 as active thesis topic, conditioned on feasibility pilot gate.

superseded_interpretations.original_interpretation: Layer jamming for variable-stiffness continuum robots is novel in principle based on 54 seed papers.
superseded_interpretations.historical_evidence: 54 discovery seed papers lacked an integrated continuum layer-jamming beam model.
superseded_interpretations.later_evidence: Narang et al. 2018 ('Mechanically versatile soft machines through laminar jamming') and Caruso et al. 2023 ('Layer jamming modeling and experimental validation').
superseded_interpretations.reason_superseded: Narang 2018 and Caruso 2023 already developed laminar jamming continuum models, friction-slip transitions, and experimental validation.
superseded_interpretations.replacement_interpretation: Broad layer jamming novelty is completely pre-empted; formulated provisional pivot candidate P1 (validity limits of homogenized slip model).

superseded_interpretations.original_interpretation: P1 candidate: Developing a homogenized slip continuum model for high-layer-count vacuum-jammed beams is novel.
superseded_interpretations.historical_evidence: Narang 2018 and Caruso 2023 tested low layer counts.
superseded_interpretations.later_evidence: Zhang et al. 2025 ('A continuum-based model for a layer jamming beam', Mech. Sci., 16, 821-2025).
superseded_interpretations.reason_superseded: Zhang et al. (2025) already formulated and published a continuum-based model with interlayer slip for layer-jamming beams.
superseded_interpretations.replacement_interpretation: Adopt Zhang et al. 2025 as baseline model M1; evaluate output-specific model-form error boundaries against a verified full-layer reference (R) and experiments (E).

superseded_interpretations.original_interpretation: Broad candidate MP1 architecture (superelastic NiTi wire bundle + positive pressure + SMA piston + jamming) is novel.
superseded_interpretations.historical_evidence: Mentor proposal combining NiTi superelasticity with positive-pressure confinement.
superseded_interpretations.later_evidence: MP1-V001 literature audit showing prior art on wire jamming (C1), positive pressure jamming (C2), SMA+jamming (C3), compact pressure sources (C4, C8).
superseded_interpretations.reason_superseded: Broad system architecture was an uninventive assembly of known subcomponents, all with direct prior art.
superseded_interpretations.replacement_interpretation: Pivoted MP1 to mechanics core: constitutive-contact coupling between NiTi transformation and inter-wire frictional contact.

superseded_interpretations.original_interpretation: Master Plan V5 architecture is sufficient for execution kickoff.
superseded_interpretations.historical_evidence: Plan V5 completed 12 worker readiness contracts and 15 hard gates.
superseded_interpretations.later_evidence: Audit D1-A5 identified A5-HI-01 (ownership graph conflicts) and A5-HI-02 (generic S16-only failure routes).
superseded_interpretations.reason_superseded: Shared-write ambiguities and unrouted failure paths created high risk of orphan outputs and execution deadlocks.
superseded_interpretations.replacement_interpretation: Plan V6 established strict single-writer ownership (40 rows, 0 conflicts) and 26 per-worker failure routes.

corrected_interpretations.original_interpretation: In D1-V007, focal paper ca46dc062d was interpreted as having supported a predeclared 5% acceptance tolerance.
corrected_interpretations.corrected_interpretation: Paper ca46dc062d adopted a 5% error threshold post-hoc during validation inspection, but did NOT predeclare it a priori before validation data was examined.
corrected_interpretations.scientific_consequence: Predeclared acceptance tolerance remains an unaddressed standard in prior art; reinforced surviving novelty gap of D1/M1 and established Hard Gate HG-06 (Threshold freeze before validation).

corrected_interpretations.original_interpretation: In early MP1 reviews, Carboni 2015 was cited as an example of NiTi frictional contact under bending.
corrected_interpretations.corrected_interpretation: Carboni 2015 specimen S2a was a pure steel wire cable with friction; only S1a was a NiTi specimen (subjected to combined tension-bending).
corrected_interpretations.scientific_consequence: Corrected factual citation record and prevented false-kill attribution on MP1.
